summary: Grilled the enforcement-gates plan on its two genuine design forks (where the story-PR link is written; how Gate A treats window-PRs) plus the CI-testability limit. All resolved; no contradictions with the active decision corpus (adds CI + intake gates, does not touch pr_ready's frozen surface per 0009).
gaps: Where the story-PR link is written was underspecified — a merge workflow implies CI writing to main (permissions, branch-protection friction, a bot commit per merge).
Gate A's treatment of PRs that ship from a lite/quickfix window rather than a story was not stated.
The Verify Plan cannot falsify the CI workflow YAML itself, only the check scripts.
resolutions: Auto-link on the PR BRANCH pre-merge: a pull_request workflow runs forge pr-link once the PR number exists and commits the pr-linked event to the branch (loop-guarded), so the link travels in the merge and no CI writes to main.
Window-PRs cite Ticket: <window-id> and prove themselves by their ledger done record in the diff; they are exempt from the story invariant. Keeps the lite/quickfix small-fix lanes viable.

The deterministic core is the two check scripts (unit-tested against fixture diffs/roadmaps/events); the workflow YAML is thin wiring and Gate A self-tests on this very PR (which resolves to FORGE-BOARD-1 with its done-flip + history in the diff).
